ActiveTaskInfo.description: Display identity of a task whose subprocess is currently registered.

CacheExperiment.description: Target prefix reuse, independent of generated reuse or observed cache hits.

CacheExperimentOutcome.description: Small task result; the experiment manifest contains subrun details.

CacheExperimentPlan.description: A reproducible plan and its request budget.

CacheObservation.description: Server-reported cache-read token totals and their actual coverage.

CachePlanConfiguration.description: Reproducible configuration without inference or telemetry credentials.

CacheRepetitionItem.description: One planned repetition with its independently observed metric.

CacheRequestGroup.description: A group defined only by the server's request-level cached token count.

CacheSubrunPlan.description: One uniquely named, independently seeded matrix member.

ClientProgress.description: AIPerf client counters, distinct from all server node metrics.

EventType.description: Canonical event kinds emitted by the AgentLoop or external-agent bridge.

ExecutionSubset.description: Completion counts for one evaluated subset.

ExecutionSummary.description: Run completeness kept separate from aggregation-specific metric counts.

HistogramWindow.description: Window bucket deltas and approximate quantiles, never averaged percentiles.

JudgeSummary.description: First-class summary of a judge session, for reports and offline inspection.

LiveGauge.description: A single unaggregated gauge series from one actual node scrape.

LoadConfiguration.description: Load points and budgets shared by all experiment scenarios.

LoadPoint.description: One closed-loop concurrency or open-loop request rate.

MetricDisplayKind.description: How a metric value is rendered.

MetricKind.description: Whether a metric grades quality or only describes a run.

MetricMapping.description: One exact upstream metric family and its non-aggregated semantics.

MetricStatistics.description: A metric with explicit unit, scope, source, and observation count.

MetricWindow.description: An explicit profiling window in the collector's nanosecond clock.

NodeCacheRatio.description: vLLM lookup-token ratio; never confused with response cache usage.

NodeMetricSample.description: One source-attributed raw sample; no request-level PD inference is made.

NodeMetricWindow.description: A single node/label series with upstream definition and measured window.

NodeMetricsAnalysis.description: Bounded node analysis and the provenance of its profiling interval.

NodePreflight.description: A single endpoint's reachability and documented matching families.

NodeScrapeSummary.description: Observed successful scrapes; failures are unknown when not exported.

PerfEngineCapability.description: Public availability of a performance execution engine.

PerfInvokeResponse.description: Typed AIPerf task result, compatible with the shared task monitor.

PerfLiveResponse.description: Bounded last node scrapes and the current planned scenario, when available.

PerfPlanResponse.description: A side-effect-free cache experiment plan and its limitations.

PerfRequestRecord.description: A request record without inferred server cache data.

PerfRunResult.description: A normalized run; raw files remain the source of truth.

PerfSinglePlanResponse.description: Preflight for one inline-prompt AIPerf run.

PlannedMetricNode.description: Credential-free identity of a configured telemetry node.

PredictionScore.description: Score fields rendered by the Web UI; metadata remains benchmark-defined.

ProgressResponse.description: Progress tracker payload with stable fields and tracker-specific metadata.

PublicAIPerfOutcome.description: Single-run outcome without local paths or credentials.

ReportGroup.description: One row per model in a `group_by=model` listing - display-only rollup, never a merged report.

RequestLatencyDistribution.description: Exact nearest-rank percentiles for observed request latencies.

ScoreStatus.description:
Whether a score is usable, and why it is not.

A failed judge is not a zero: only ``SUCCESS`` and ``FALLBACK`` carry a score that may
enter aggregation. The remaining values mean the score is unavailable and the sample
must be excluded from the affected metric rather than counted as 0.

TraceUsage.description: Mirrors `evalscope.api.model.model_output.ModelUsage`'s shape for the response contract.

WindowStatistic.description: A window value with coverage and explicit boundary semantics.
